findings.title: State's Liability Limited to Appropriated Funds
findings.fact: The State shall have no liability under this contract beyond funds appropriated and available for this contract.

quotes.quote: In accordance with Section 41 of the State Finance Law, the State shall have no liability under this contract to the Contractor or to anyone else beyond funds appropriated and available for this contract.

findings.title: Contract Void Without Workers' Compensation Coverage
findings.fact: The contract shall be void and of no force and effect unless the Contractor provides and maintains workers' compensation coverage during the life of the contract.

quotes.quote: In accordance with Section 142 of the State Finance Law, this contract shall be void and of no force and effect unless the Contractor shall provide and maintain coverage during the life of this contract for the benefit of such employees as are required to be covered by the provisions of the Workers' Compensation Law.

findings.title: State's Set-Off Rights
findings.fact: The State has the right to withhold any moneys due to the Contractor under this contract to offset any amounts due and owing to the State, including tax delinquencies and monetary penalties.

quotes.quote: The State shall have all of its common law, equitable and statutory rights of set-off. These rights shall include, but not be limited to, the State's option to withhold for the purposes of set-off any moneys due to the Contractor under this contract up to any amounts due and owing to the State with regard to this contract, any other contract with any State department or agency, including any contract for a term commencing prior to the term of this contract, plus any amounts due and owing to the State for any other reason including, without limitation, tax delinquencies, fee delinquencies or monetary penalties relative thereto.

findings.title: No Binding Arbitration; Court Jurisdiction
findings.fact: Disputes must be heard in a court of competent jurisdiction of the State of New York; binding arbitration is prohibited except where statutorily authorized.

quotes.quote: Disputes involving this contract, including the breach or alleged breach thereof, may not be submitted to binding arbitration (except where statutorily authorized), but must, instead, be heard in a court of competent jurisdiction of the State of New York.

findings.title: Governing Law: New York
findings.fact: The contract shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York except where federal supremacy requires otherwise.

quotes.quote: This contract shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York except where the Federal supremacy clause requires otherwise.

findings.title: Termination for False Certification
findings.fact: DTF may terminate the Agreement if the Offerer's certification under State Finance Law §139-k was intentionally false or incomplete.

quotes.quote: DTF reserves the right to terminate this Agreement in the event it is found that the certification filed by the Offerer/bidder in accordance with New York State Finance Law §139-k was intentionally false or intentionally incomplete.

findings.title: Termination for Unacceptable Replacement Devices
findings.fact: The Department reserves the right to terminate the Agreement if replacement GPS devices are deemed unacceptable.

quotes.quote: The Department reserves the right to terminate the Agreement if such replacement devices are deemed unacceptable.

findings.title: Fines and Termination for Non-Discrimination Violations
findings.fact: Contractor is subject to fines of $50.00 per person per day for violations of certain non-discrimination provisions, and possible termination and forfeiture of all moneys due for a second or subsequent violation.

quotes.quote: Contractor is subject to fines of $50.00 per person per day for any violation of Section 220-e or Section 239 as well as possible termination of this contract and forfeiture of all moneys due hereunder for a second or subsequent violation.

findings.title: Contract Forfeit for International Boycott Violation
findings.fact: If the Contractor or affiliates are found to have violated international boycott laws, the contract shall be rendered forfeit and void.

quotes.quote: If such Contractor, or any of the aforesaid affiliates of Contractor, is convicted or is otherwise found to have violated said laws or regulations upon the final determination of the United States Commerce Department or any other appropriate agency of the United States subsequent to the contract's execution, such contract, amendment or modification thereto shall be rendered forfeit and void.

findings.title: No Liability for Goods or Services Not Received
findings.fact: The Department will not pay any costs associated with goods or services that have not been received.

quotes.quote: The Department will not pay any costs associated with goods or services that have not been received.
